dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, the party was fun, but look at the kitchen!
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, ðə ˈpɑːrti wʌz ˈfʌn, bʌt ˈlʊk ət ðə ˈkɪtʃən!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I know. Let's clean it up together.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. ˈlɛts ˈkliːn ɪt ˈʌp təˈɡɛðər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Can you take out the trash?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. kən juː ˈteɪk ˈaʊt ðə ˈtræʃ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Sure. I'll take it out now.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. aɪl ˈteɪk ɪt ˈaʊt ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks. These bottles are empty. Should I throw them away?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. ðiːz ˈbɑːtəlz ər ˈɛmpti. ʃʊd aɪ ˈθroʊ ðɛm əˈweɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, don't throw them away! We can use them for flowers.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ˈdoʊnt ˈθroʊ ðɛm əˈweɪ! wiː kən ˈjuːz ðɛm fər ˈflaʊərz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. And whose jacket is this?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ənd ˈhuːz ˈdʒækɪt ɪz ˈðɪs?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It's Ploy's. Please hang it up. She'll come back for it tomorrow.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈplɔɪz. ˈpliːz ˈhæŋ ɪt ˈʌp. ʃiːl ˈkʌm ˈbæk fər ɪt təˈmɑːroʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And the clean glasses? Should I put them away?
dialogue.reading: ənd ðə ˈkliːn ˈɡlæsɪz? ʃʊd aɪ ˈpʊt ðɛm əˈweɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, please put them away. Thanks, Nam!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈpliːz ˈpʊt ðɛm əˈweɪ. ˈθæŋks, ˈnɑːm!
